reassessment_reason: Narrow schema discovery to validating the current delivery against the already published tagged-record specification; retain unresolved delivery, rights and identity gates.

access.bulk: The official catalog describes comma-delimited corporate extracts compressed into ZIP files. The fee page lists corporate bulk data at $0.02 per record; new-entity reports are $80, with subscriptions separately listed at $80/month.
access.api: No supported unattended bulk API, authenticated transfer contract or rate-limit policy was established.
access.search: Indexed official search-page text warns that results are limited. Direct retrieval returned HTTP 403 to the web reader; no query was submitted or access restriction bypassed.

fields.summary: The public Version 2 specification dated April 26, 2017 defines tagged entity/child rows, Business Entity Number joins, status/date fields and seven-component addresses. Current delivery compatibility remains unverified; a public layout is not a validated package.

active_status_semantics: Status descriptions include active and inactive examples, and some entity types have inactive reasons/dates. These are not proof of current business operation; a complete current codebook is unresolved.
statewide_completeness: Catalog scope includes corporations, LLCs, partnerships, assumed/foreign names, trademarks and bonds. These are distinct record populations; delivered subtype coverage and counts require validation before any business completeness claim.
address_zip: The older specification identifies principal-office mailing addresses and separate agent/person-role addresses. Exclude person-role rows from business projection; preserve address roles and ZIP5/ZIP4 separately.
automation_terms_fees: The current fee schedule supports a paid bulk route but does not establish an executable quote, account requirements, automation authorization or an accepted order.
redistribution: Retention, derived-use and redistribution rights were not established by the technical specification or fee schedule; public documentation does not grant product-specific rights.
temporal_refresh: The specification's 2017 revision is historical contract evidence. The HTML catalog's 2026 table timestamps are publication metadata, not source-release freshness. Refresh, deletions, correction replay, counts and checksums remain unresolved.

citations.evidence: Official current HTML catalog documents tagged comma-delimited extracts, entity scopes and joins.
Version 2 dated April 26, 2017 defines record layouts and principal/agent/person address roles.
Indexed official page warns results are limited; direct retrieval returned HTTP 403 and no enumeration was attempted.

strongest_next_action: Use the published layout to prepare a current-version compatibility checklist, person-role exclusion map and precise unresolved contract questions. Before acquisition, resolve subtype counts, stable keys, current status/address semantics, refresh/replay controls, price and product rights. HOLD remains accurate; no purchase, contact or acquisition authority is added.
